articles.summary: Download this white paper to learn how organizations can establish trust across every device in AI infrastructure and modern data centers as heterogeneous processors, accelerators, and controllers become increasingly prevalent. Discover how the open-source Caliptra Root of Trust framework provides a common foundation for device identity, measured boot, and attestation across data center-class systems, and explore the challenges and best practices for transforming an open standard into a production-ready deployment. Learn how enterprises can stay aligned with the Caliptra ecosystem while accelerating implementation, reducing integration risk, and achieving enterprise-grade security for data center and AI infrastructure.
articles.title: From Caliptra Foundation to Full Production Deployment
